eligible_actor: usuario/a acreditado de INDAP (Agricultura Familiar Campesina), sin deuda morosa, en territorios del ciclo
amount_note: 2-year cycle. Yr1 Capital Inicial de Transición: up to 95% / max CLP 450,000 (asignación directa). Yr2 Inversiones de Transición: concursable up to 90% / max CLP 3,500,000. Plus 6 asesorías técnicas + 4 capacitaciones grupales/yr. Subject to budget availability.
access_pathway: direct application (facilitated by INDAP area agency)
notes: Climate-explicit: agroecología, resiliencia frente al cambio climático, escasez hídrica. 16 regions; 2nd cycle 2025-2027, postulation 13-29 Oct 2025 (closed now). Norma Técnica REX 24376. RECURRENCE=cycle-based (re-opens per 2-yr cycle), not permanent-standing.

program: Sistema de Incentivos para la Sustentabilidad Agroambiental de los Suelos Agropecuarios (SIRSD-S)
eligible_actor: usuario/a acreditado de INDAP (AFC) con suelos degradados; operador acreditado formula el plan de manejo
amount_note: INDAP finances up to 90% of net cost per the vigente tabla de costos (Decreto 16/2024), plus the technical-assistance cost; applicant funds the remainder. Subprogramas: fertilización fosforada, elementos químicos esenciales, coberturas vegetales, métodos anti-erosión, eliminación de impedimentos físico-químicos.
access_pathway: direct application via regional public concursos (Dirección Regional)
notes: Climate-explicit: soil recovery, erosion control, vegetal cover. Statutory basis Ley 20.412. Regional concursos with dates published per Dirección Regional. RECURRENCE=annual standing instrument.

program: Programa de Riego (Obras Menores de Riego / riego intrapredial-asociativo)
eligible_actor: usuario/a INDAP (AFC), individual o asociativo; comunidades de aguas
amount_note: Co-financing of on-farm irrigation works/technification; ceilings set in the program norma técnica / concurso bases (confirm at build of any city row).
access_pathway: direct application via Concursos de Fomento
notes: Climate-explicit: irrigation / water security / adaptation to escasez hídrica. Standing annual instrument in the Concursos de Programas de Fomento. Confirm exact amounts against bases.

eligible_actor: Microproductores AFC (persona natural/jurídica); city role = implementer (municipal convenio)
amount_note: Three components: Asesoría Técnica (AT), Capital de Trabajo (CT, ex-FOA), Inversiones de activos productivos (IFP), by microproducer typology. Amounts in the norma técnica / procedimiento operativo.
notes: Mandate explicitly includes adaptación y resiliencia al cambio climático, escasez hídrica y reconversión productiva, though program is general rural extension (specificity=broad). Executed BY municipalities under convenio -> city is implementer, not just enabler. Solicitud todo el año. Norma Técnica REX 0070-53141 (18.11.2025).

program: Programa de Desarrollo Territorial Indígena (PDTI, convenio INDAP-CONADI)
eligible_actor: pueblos indígenas (familias, comunidades, organizaciones) con actividad silvoagropecuaria; city role = implementer (municipal convenio)
amount_note: Extension teams (asesoría técnica permanente) + Fondo Único de Financiamiento for users' investment needs; amounts via convenio/contrato.
notes: Indigenous rural development; municipal-delivered like PRODESAL -> city is implementer. Permanent standing program. Climate-adjacent (general silvoagropecuario development).

amount_note: Co-financed technical advisory for productive/commercial development; amounts per norma técnica / concurso.
access_pathway: direct application via Concursos de Fomento
notes: General technical-advisory instrument; climate-adjacent where advisory targets sustainable practices. Standing annual instrument.

eligible_actor: usuario/a INDAP (AFC) articulado con un poder comprador
amount_note: Co-financed advisory + investment to link smallholders with buyers; amounts per norma técnica / concurso.
access_pathway: direct application via Concursos de Fomento
notes: Market-linkage program; climate relevance indirect. Standing annual instrument.

amount_note: Co-finances on-farm productive investments; ceilings per norma técnica / concurso bases.
access_pathway: direct application via Concursos de Fomento
notes: General productive-investment instrument; climate relevance indirect (can fund irrigation/energy works). Standing annual instrument.

eligible_actor: usuario/a INDAP (AFC), individual o empresas asociativas campesinas
amount_note: Short- and long-term credit lines for working capital and investment; rates/ceilings per credit policy.
notes: Rolling credit, not a concurso. Climate relevance indirect (finances any AFC investment, incl. irrigation/soil). Permanent standing instrument.
